rubric.name: growth-round-outcomes plan r3
criteria: MVP first: classify every concern as blocking, hardening, or completeness, and report blocking concerns first. A concern is blocking only if, left unfixed, the software does not demonstrably do what it claims. Do not manufacture completeness concerns to avoid an empty return -- "no concerns, and here is what I checked" is a valid answer.
For this plan, a concern is blocking only if, left unfixed, a phase cannot be specified, implemented or tested as written, or the milestone would not do what its goal claims.

This is round 2. r3 applies round 1's findings, each change tagged (p1); the disposition at .gnd-planning/milestones/growth-round-outcomes/evidence/plan-review-r1/disposition.md lists them. Check first whether each (p1) change resolves its finding without creating a new defect, and report a concern about unchanged text only if it is blocking.

Can each phase GO1, GO2, GO3, GO4 and GO5 be specified, implemented and tested as section 2 and section 4 write it, within the scope sections 1 and 7 state? Is any criterion in section 4 impossible, unfalsifiable or dependent on one machine's speed?
Does each code location, line number and quoted message cited in the plan match the repository at this checkout? Read the cited lines in src/gnd and tests before reporting a mismatch.

GO1: is a per-invocation parse cache keyed by content and reader, sharing one document object between callers, safe? Can any caller of parse_model_document inside gnd evolve (src/gnd/evolve/service.py, src/gnd/model/__init__.py, src/gnd/model/_includes.py) write into the returned document, and do the controls of section 6 and criterion GO1-C3 catch it? Does R0.2 (no check removed) hold?

Do the binding rules of section 0, the decisions of section 10 and the controls of section 6 agree with each other and with the criteria? In particular: can GO2's per-operation verdicts be computed for refusals that happen today as one whole-proposal EvolutionError; does GO3's narrowed proposal keep apply whole (R0.1) and stale-preview refusal; does GO5's summary have discriminating fixtures?

Are the order, dependencies, homes and verification lanes of sections 3 and 9 consistent, acyclic and sufficient for each criterion, including the one-writer-at-a-time order with the reviewed-vocabulary-growth milestone on src/gnd/evolve/service.py and unattended-growth.md?

The GO1 draft spec at .gnd-planning/milestones/growth-round-outcomes/notes/phase-GO1-spec.md may be read for context; a concern about it must still cite the plan file and name the spec line in the observation.
Every concern's evidence must cite the plan file.
